metadata.title: Centro-affine spectral geometry of polytopes
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we develop a polyhedral version of Milman's centro-affine spectral framework for full-dimensional origin-symmetric polytopes. A weighted graph Laplacian on the facets plays the role of the smooth centro-affine Laplacian. For $n\geq 3$, we prove that its first nonconstant even eigenvalue satisfies \[ \lambda_{1,e}(P)\geq n-1+\frac{1}{n-1} \] whenever $P$ is a local minimizer of $\lambda_{1,e}$ among origin-symmetric polytopes with the same facet normals, but not necessarily the same normal fan.
